comment: The kinds Apple Health fills in. The server seeds them into entry_kinds and checks every synced item against them; the iOS HealthCatalog is checked against this file. quantity_field is the data field the entry's quantity equals (none: quantity is 1). required fields must be present; ranges are inclusive [min, max]; a quantity field's minimum is the smallest rounded value above 0. day_total: one number per day, even when it has several entries (a night plus an addition), so a card's latest block shows the day's total.
